text: Landed; ticket was never closed. RecordRef names an ArtifactId, not a path, so a sidecar resolves inside the verified snapshot by construction. VerificationFailure.DanglingRecordRef is raised at manifest.scala:109 (build time) and :258 (resolve time). SidecarSuite.scala covers a ref resolving to nothing, two refs resolving to one artifact, and schema/version disagreement. Changed sidecar bytes are caught by the same checksum path as any other artifact -- which is the point of naming an ArtifactId rather than a path.
